title: The secret behind Tommy Vercetti's ambush in GTA Vice City
subject: tommy
description:
Did you suspect Diaz from the start? 👇

The man who ordered the Vice City ambush was the one handing Tommy his jobs. Spoilers for GTA Vice City.

scenes.text: The man behind the ambush was paying Tommy's wages.
Ricardo Diaz, Vice City's biggest cocaine dealer, kept hiring Tommy while hiding that he had ordered the hit.
Lance Vance, whose brother Victor died at the deal, worked it out first.
He went after Diaz alone and ended up beaten in a junkyard, until Tommy pulled him out in the mission Death Row.
Then the two of them stormed Diaz's mansion on Starfish Island in Rub Out.
The mansion became the Vercetti Estate. Tommy built his empire inside the house of the man who robbed him.
